value.rationale: Provides the exact universal simple-negative-root property for the complete minimal-facet class of smooth lattice threefolds, strengthening a recent positivity-only classification. Covers arbitrarily large integer twists and width-one members, which are not automatically covered by large-width, magic-positive, or Cartesian-product preservation results. Real-rootedness yields log-concavity and unimodality in a natural infinite family.
